headline: Executive order sets up how the U.S. carries out an added nuclear safeguards agreement with the International Atomic Energy Agency.
what_it_does: This order deals with putting into effect an extra agreement, called an Additional Protocol, between the United States and the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA). The IAEA is the United Nations agency that checks how nuclear materials are used. Based on the title alone, the order appears to organize how the federal government will carry out the agreement's safeguard rules inside the United States. No summary was provided, so the specific duties and agencies involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They would likely be given roles in carrying out the protocol's requirements.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. sites and organizations with nuclear-related activities
who_it_affects.how: They may face reporting or access requests tied to IAEA safeguards, though the details are not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on February 4, 2008, though the source does not say.
